title: Derived internal Hom from a pseudo-coherent module preserves bounded-below quasi-coherence
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-algebra which is pseudo-coherent as an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-pur-pseudo-coherent-complex], and let $K$ be an object of $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Then $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(A,K)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with its natural $A$-module structure [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module], belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(A)$ [def-pc-derived-category-qcoh-algebra]; after forgetting the $A$-module structure it belongs to $D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.
